summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K on August 25, 2026, to furnish an investor presentation accompanying its H1 2026 financial results. The presentation contains forward-looking statements, non-IFRS measures, and industry data, but no transaction or special-situation event. The filing is a routine disclosure of periodic results, not a merger, tender, strategic review, or other corporate action. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. The filing serves only to provide investors with updated operational and financial information. No risk-arb or event-driven angle applies; it is a standard earnings-related presentation.
